title: Create Voronoi polygons from five Alkmaar points
notes: The captured process description advertises InputPoints only as GML 3.1 text/xml. The inline GML payload uses the same coordinates and IDs as the canonical GeoJSON fixture; GeoJSON input was not advertised and is not assumed. The local server accepted this request on 2026-08-24 but returned 500 because its R runtime lacked readOGR; success remains the expected interoperable outcome.
